an4.5:1.1: cattāro’me bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.5:1.3: anusotagāmī puggalo, paṭisotagāmī puggalo, ṭhitatto puggalo, tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an4.5:1.5: idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca paṭisevati, pāpañca kammaṃ karoti.
an4.5:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme na paṭisevati, pāpañca kammaṃ na karoti, sahāpi dukkhena sahāpi domanassena assumukho’pi rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati.
an4.5:3.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an4.5:4.1: katamo ca bhikkhave, puggalo tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo?
an4.5:4.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.5:4.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, puggalo tiṇṇo pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an4.5:4.4: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
